vBRIEFInfo.description: Story vBRIEF for #1328 — ghx installer SHA256 mismatch must fail CI

plan.title: CI ghx installer SHA256 mismatch handler must exit non-zero

narratives.Description: The ghx pre-install step in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` uses `exit 0` when the installer SHA256 check fails on both Unix and Windows paths. That masks supply-chain integrity failures and allows a tampered installer to proceed.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Edit `.github/workflows/ci.yml` Install ghx step (~lines 206-211): on `install.ps1` SHA256 mismatch change `exit 0` to `exit 1` so CI fails closed on supply-chain drift (env `GHX_INSTALL_PS1_SHA256`).
2. Grep the workflow file to assert the mismatch branch no longer uses `exit 0`; confirm success path still dot-sources on match.
3. Add CHANGELOG security note; verify with `pnpm run lint` (YAML in repo scope).
narratives.UserStory: As a framework maintainer, I want CI to fail when the ghx installer checksum does not match the pinned value, so that supply-chain tampering cannot silently proceed.
narratives.Overview: See issue #1328 — lines ~104 (Unix) and ~207 (Windows) in ci.yml use exit 0 on mismatch.

items.title: Unix path fails on SHA256 mismatch

narrative.Acceptance: Given the Unix ghx install verification step in ci.yml, when SHA256 does not match the pinned env value, then the step exits non-zero and prints expected vs actual hash.

items.title: Windows path fails on SHA256 mismatch

narrative.Acceptance: Given the Windows ghx install verification step in ci.yml, when Get-FileHash mismatch occurs, then the step exits non-zero (not exit 0).
Given the fix lands, when CHANGELOG [Unreleased] is read, then it documents that CI now fails closed on ghx installer checksum mismatch. Closes #1328.

expected_outputs: Unix + Windows SHA256 mismatch exits non-zero
swarm.missing_traces_justification: Workflow-only security fix from ingested issue #1328.
